entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: A khan of the Jeskai Way in Tarkir's past, an ancient master fighter who collected secret knowledge and gave his life to preserve his clan.

entities.name: Jeskai Way
entities.description: Clan of Tarkir led by Shu Yun.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: Dragon who froze Shu Yun to death; the catacombs of the Ojutai held the Jeskai's secret knowledge.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: Recipient of Jeskai knowledge brought by one of Shu Yun's followers.

entities.name: Khanfall of Tarkir
entities.description: Event after which Jeskai knowledge was passed on.

entities.name: Athenaeum Festival
entities.description: Yearly festival honoring Shu Yun's devotion to keeping Tarkir's history.

events.summary: Shu Yun, 1,280 years ago, throws stones into a thousand bodies of water across Tarkir as his path to enlightenment.
events.quote: Shu Yun threw a stone into a thousand bodies of water across Tarkir

events.summary: In the catacombs of the Ojutai, Shu Yun and his disciples collect secret knowledge to preserve for Tarkir's future.
events.quote: Shu Yun and his disciples collected secret knowledge

events.summary: In the current timeline Shu Yun's meeting of the khans fails when the dragons attack, forcing the Jeskai to surrender.
events.quote: this failed as the beasts attacked, forcing the Jeskai to surrender

events.summary: To preserve his clan, Shu Yun forfeits his life and Ojutai freezes him to death.
events.quote: Shu Yun forfeited his life, resulting in Ojutai callously freezing him to death

events.summary: Eighteen years after the Khanfall, some Jeskai knowledge is brought to Yasova Dragonclaw.
events.quote: some of the Jeskai knowledge was brought to Yasova Dragonclaw by one of his followers

relations.quote: was a khan of the Jeskai Way in the past of Tarkir
